points.description: The student correctly identifies that there is no atmosphere (or air/medium) on the moon to transmit sound waves.

rubric.notes: Full marks are awarded for stating that the lack of atmosphere on the moon prevents sound from traveling. No marks are awarded if the answer is incorrect or irrelevant.
rubric.answer_key: चंद्रावर वातावरण नसल्यामुळे ध्वनी लहरींना प्रवास करण्यासाठी माध्यम मिळत नाही, म्हणून अंतराळवीर एकमेकांचे आवाज ऐकू शकत नाहीत.
